```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet,RColorBrewer)

```

```{r, echo=F}
pathtofile <- "~/Downloads/alllandwatchcrithab_2025-08-04.csv"
crithabresults <- read_csv(pathtofile)
crithabresults_pts <- crithabresults %>% 
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
  )
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = colorRampPalette(c('green', 'red'))(100),  # 100 steps in gradient
  domain = crithabresults_pts$logacreprice
)
```

<font size = "3"> This map shows undeveloped land in the US listed for sale on landwatch.com. For now, I have filtered it to listings for >100 acres that occur in the ranges of IUCN designated endangered species. </font>

##

```{r, echo=F, fig.width=14, fig.height=12, fig.align='center'}
m <- leaflet(data = crithabresults_pts) %>% 
  addTiles() %>% 
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 5,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = ~pal(logacreprice),
    popup = ~paste0(
      comname, ", ", acres, " acres in ", city, ", ", state, ": ",
      '<a href="https://www.landwatch.com', canonicalUrl, '" target="_blank">See listing</a>'
    )
  )

m
```
